name: Lauren Ziegler
reason: Health restore, re-checked 12 Nov 2026: still out. Sleep wording alone would now pass, but her site (www.laurenziegler.com, robots.txt allows us) is built around clinical insomnia treatment: her paid programme is billed as 'Innovative Insomnia Treatment' using CBT-i and ACT with clinical screening tools (Insomnia Severity Index, GAD-7, PHQ-9), she describes her work as behavioural sleep medicine with doctors and psychiatrists at a psychiatric clinic and sleep medicine centre, and the home page sells recovery from insomnia. That is clinical treatment of a condition (the brief's 'treats insomnia as a medical condition' case), and it is the main thing the site offers; her free yoga nidra page is a single sleep recording. Contact exists (form at /exploratory-call). Note for the owner: she says she is a top sleep guide on the Aura app (136k+ subscribers there).
